property_summary: For any caller admitted by the onlyJojoTeam check, a successfully deployed EmergencyOracle must have its owner equal to the deploying caller (msg.sender); the mutant instead assigns jojoTeam as owner, so for some caller the deployed oracle's owner() differs.

For any admissible caller and description, either newEmergencyOracle reverts (caller not the JOJO team) or the freshly created EmergencyOracle — at the deterministic CREATE address of c's first deployment — has its owner() equal to the calling address; the mutant sets jojoTeam as the owner so the deployed oracle's owner() is wrong for some input.
Only the JOJO team address can successfully create an emergency oracle; a non-team caller's call must revert.
